description: The record with first coordinate {n} and second coordinate {{n}} belongs to the trace set of A exactly when n belongs to A.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.IndependentFamilies.singleton_trace_record (A : Set ℕ) (n : ℕ) :
  ({n}, {{n}}) ∈ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.IndependentFamilies.traceSet A ↔ n ∈ A
